0022600174.text: The Atlanta Hawks, at 4-4 and 3-2 on the road, visit the Washington Wizards, who are 4-3 and lead the Southeast, while the Hawks sit second in the division half a game back. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Jalen Johnson (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), with Alex Sarr (knee soreness), Anthony Gill (back spasms), and Bilal Coulibaly (illness) also day-to-day, and the teams have not met yet this season. Last season the Hawks won the series 3-1, and their most recent meeting was a 126-96 Atlanta win on February 26, 2026.
